The HER2CLIMB trial demonstrated the benefit of tucatinib, trastuzumab and capecitabine (TTC) in human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-positive advanced breast cancer (ABC). However, it predated the clinical use of trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd), leaving limited evidence for TTC after T-DXd exposure. This national multicenter study assessed the real-world effectiveness and safety of TTC in patients, including those previously treated with T-DXd.

This retrospective, non-interventional study included patients with HER2-positive ABC treated with TTC across 17 centers in Portugal (October 2021-May 2025). Outcomes included overall response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS), and safety.
